name: flights
title: Flights
description: A live boarding pass for json-render chats, shaped like a ticket with a tear-off stub: the route over a world map, passenger, cabin and extras, boarding time, terminal, gate, group and seat. Plus a travel assistant that searches and books flights (a route card with searchable cities, a calendar, and results) and checks you in (bags, a seat on a seat map, extras) with Fluid Functionalism's AskUserQuestions (taps and validated short answers, no model needed), then shows the pass. With its API routes and a demo booking to replace with your own.

files.content:
import type { BoardingPassData } from "@/features/flights/flight-schema";

type Leg = readonly [code: string, city: string, airport: string];

const AIRPORTS = {

type Airport = keyof typeof AIRPORTS;

const placeOf = (code: Airport) => {
  const [iata, city, airport] = AIRPORTS[code];

const BOARDING_TIMES = ["07:40", "09:15", "10:05", "13:30", "18:45", "21:10"];

  Business: "2",
  Economy: "5",
  First: "1",
  Premium: "3",
  "Upper Class": "1",

/**
The demo passes for the docs gallery, all for Jon Doe on November 3, 2026.
*/
export const FAKE_PASSES: readonly BoardingPassData[] = DEMO_PASSES.map(
  ([airline, airlineCode, flight, from, to, seat, cabin, gate], index) => ({
    airline,
    airlineCode,
    boardingTime: BOARDING_TIMES[index % BOARDING_TIMES.length],
    cabin,
    date: "2026-11-03",
    demo: true,
    departureTime: DEPARTURE_TIMES[index % DEPARTURE_TIMES.length],
    flight,
    from: placeOf(from),
    gate,
    group: GROUPS_BY_CABIN[cabin] ?? "4",
    passenger: "Jon Doe",
    seat,
    terminal: String((index % 5) + 1),
    to: placeOf(to),

docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   BoardingPass: boardingPassCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: BoardingPass: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveBoardingPassCard flight={props.flight || undefined} date={props.date} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     BoardingPass: boardingPassLookup

Passes load from /api/flights and check-in from /api/flights/check-in (installed under app/api/flights/). Routes come from adsbdb, no API key. Replace getBooking and getSeatMap in features/flights/flight-booking.ts with your booking system.

The check-in assistant (features/flights/components/check-in-agent.tsx) is a standalone page component: render <CheckInAgent className="flex-1" /> in a full-height column. Its conversation is a script in features/flights/check-in-conversation.ts; replace demoBookingOf there with a request to your booking system.
